title: Comparative Performance of Claude and GPT Models in Basic Radiological Imaging Tasks

prompt.location: Table 2 (system prompts for MURAv1.1 and ROCOv2)

claim.metric: anatomical region identification accuracy, ROCOv2 subset
claim.location: Table 3, column gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, row Total, Anat Id (%)

data.source: ROCOv2 (public) 100-image subset manually screened, image list not given; MURAv1.1 300-image subset manually selected

resolution.plan: The 100 ROCOv2 images are an unlisted, manually screened subset whose strata are given in Table 1 (CT 40: abdomen/pelvis 15, chest 14, brain 10, spine 1; MRI 31: brain 15, spine 16; X-ray 29: chest 10, abdomen 3, skeletal 16), with modality/region ground truth from the dataset CSV metadata. Draw a seeded stratified sample matching Table 1 from the public ROCOv2 release, drop images with burnt-in annotations or poor quality, send each with the Table 2 ROCOv2 system prompt to gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at default temperature, and score anatomical-region accuracy; compare with 78/100 (Table 3).
resolution.approximation: Different images and screening; set-level comparison (binomial spread of roughly +/-8 points at n=100).
